basics.name: Jian Zhao
basics.headline: AI Research Scientist | Biomedical AI · LLMs · Graph Neural Networks | Tsinghua M.S. | U.S. Ph.D. Candidate

summary.name: Summary
summary.content: AI researcher and software engineer with Tsinghua University graduate training, U.S. master's and Ph.D. research, and 10+ years spanning biomedical AI, graph learning, computer vision, LLM applications, HPC, and enterprise systems. Combines interdisciplinary healthcare research with production software engineering, multi-institution collaboration, and hands-on Python and PyTorch development.

items.company: Temple University, College of Public Health
items.summary:
• Developed EMMA, an LLM-based assistant for postpartum-depression support using LLaMA/ChatGPT, RAG, PEFT, Milvus, Neo4j, Flowise, Gradio, and Streamlit to connect users with locally relevant resources
  • Applied Random Forest, XGBoost, and SVM to ambulatory-visit and public-health data, identifying blood-pressure and A1C monitoring gaps and supporting hypertension-prediction research
  • Designed AI and data workflows spanning EHR, environmental sensors, and public-health repositories; contributed manuscripts, grant proposals, technical documentation, and cross-disciplinary research supervision

• Research biomedical cell segmentation, tracking, and quantification using mathematical algorithms, image processing, CNNs, GNNs, and LLM-assisted parameter tuning for microscopy applications
  • Developed a rapid-tuning approach for CSTQ parameters supporting reproducible biomedical image-analysis and disease-research workflows
  • Conduct large-scale nano-bio spectroscopy and plasma simulations using MPI, OpenMP, GPU computing, OSIRIS, and GROMACS in collaborations with Princeton, UCLA, and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

• Built and administered an HPC research cluster with 8 compute nodes, 320 CPUs, and 512 GB RAM for nano-bio spectroscopy simulations and data-intensive experiments
  • Completed ML projects in pattern recognition and dimensionality reduction (PCA, LDA, LLE), and investigated visible-light access control for wireless insulin-pump security

• Developed BP neural-network and decision-tree models for natural-gas pipeline energy forecasting, achieving approximately 90% accuracy for strategic planning analyses
  • Built an M/M/C vehicle-allocation model and delivered analytics and enterprise software using MATLAB, Java, SQL, Weka, and statistical modeling

• Led a five-person Sino-German national forest-pest-control information-system project, delivering a scalable browser/server application for the National Forestry program
  • Modernized Forest News from ASP to JSP and migrated Access to Oracle 9i using Java, Spring, Hibernate, Struts, JUnit, and GIS technologies
Research in biomedical AI, graph neural networks, and HPC simulation. Collaborations with Princeton, UCLA, and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory.
Software architecture, enterprise systems, and project management. Vice President, Science & Technology Association, School of Software.
